notes: Prepared as the next RDE-01 cabinet fit plate. One letter grille and one of each back panel. Red PLA Basic AMS A1, textured PEI 55 °C, nozzle 220 °C, 0.15 mm layers (0.20 mm first), three walls, 15% infill and 5 mm brims. Supports are off. The print uses red instead of the manual’s black cabinet colour. The original red archive is held for dispatch because it lacks the newly required carved part numbers. A marked successor requires a fresh audit.
